title: MissionPlan
description: THE INTERFACE CONTRACT. The LLM layer produces this; the drone-control layer consumes it via execute_mission(plan). Everyone reads this file; only change it by agreeing with the whole team.

mission_id.description: Assigned by the orchestrator, not the LLM. e.g. 'm-20260905-0001'.

planner.description: What produced this plan: a model id like 'claude-opus-5', or 'mock'.

reasoning.description: Plain-language justification. Shown in the dashboard and the incident report.

waypoint.description: One step of the mission. Altitudes are metres above ground level at the base. Coordinates are WGS84 decimal degrees.

action.description: 'flyto' transits to the point. 'hover' holds position and collects sensor observations.

duration_s.description: Seconds to hold. Must be 0 for 'flyto'.

purpose.description: One short line: why this waypoint exists. e.g. 'observe fence line from the north'.
